description:
Unwind bl-a764. Git branches already exist on disk — git branch --list ex/* is the unmerged-branches query. branches.json was a mirror of git state, a duplication that violates the (newly added) single-source principle.

=== Scope ===
- Delete src/prompt/branches.rs and its call-site in dispatch.rs (rev-parse + append_open).
- Remove branches.json references from ARCH §2.2 layout, §2.3 'Unmerged-branch tracking' paragraph, §8 metric text, and the v0.2 milestone blurb.
- Remove the template/.gitignore entry for branches.json (the file shouldn't exist anywhere; no need to ignore what we never create).
- Add a 'Single source of truth' principle to docs/PRINCIPLES.md and cross-reference from ARCH where relevant.
- README: replace the jq-on-branches.json example with git branch --list ex/* (or rev-list) for the unmerged-count recipe.
- Tests: update integration test + dispatch unit tests to assert via git refs instead of branches.json.
- Regression: bl-e7e1's tests must continue to pass.

=== Out of scope ===
- Refactoring other existing state files (events.log stays as-is; this task is specifically the branches.json retraction plus the principle).

=== Why ===
User feedback 2026-04-22: 'Why do we need a branches.json? Branches exist. They are on disk. Just ask git.' The ARCH doc had branches.json in the §2.2 layout from the outset; bl-a764 faithfully implemented a design that was wrong at the spec level. This task corrects the spec and code together.
title: Retire branches.json; add single-source-of-truth principle
